summary: Backend-only testing for iteration 2 changes (3-people shifts, Smontante+Riposo, admin management, role-based leave notifications). 12/12 pytest tests passed against the public Expo backend URL.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/users/{user_id}/admin uses query param `value` typed as bool; FastAPI parses 'true'/'false' OK. Works as designed.
POST /api/leaves notifies all same-role members EXCEPT the requester ($ne user_id) - correct behavior verified.
PATCH /api/leaves only notifies the leave['user_id'] (requester) - correct.
Smontante+Riposo: after each Notte, all 3 assignees get rest_until = D+2 inclusive; pick_user respects it. Verified across full month 2026-07.
Note: server.py is 641 lines; consider splitting into routers (users, shifts, leaves, swaps) if it grows further.

Note: PATCH /shifts (modify shift) endpoint not implemented - only POST/DELETE. If admin should 'modify' shifts per requirements, this may be a gap. However, the test request did not ask to verify it.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ leave request (approved) and one TEST_ swap (accepted) on shifts in 2026-07. These remain in DB but won't impact normal flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 backend rules verified: 9 shifts/day (3 per shift type, one per role), Smontante+Riposo enforced after every Notte assignment, single-admin enforcement via PATCH /api/users/{id}/admin?value=true, leave creation notifies only other same-role members (not requester, not other roles), and leave approve/reject notifies only the requester. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env) for the public base URL. Test data is prefixed with TEST_ in reason/message fields.
